title: Unraveling Purpose & Success: Part 4
summary: Part 4 of the Success series. Kahran reflects on Divya's interview with his father Pradeep — surprised that Pradeep had never felt successful despite a full career — and uses it to question whether success is always a moving goalpost or can be a state of mind you settle into. They detour into Kahran's MFA, revision as a tool, ergodic literature (House of Leaves), and the FromSoftware Souls-like school of game design where difficulty is the meaning.
topics: right answers in art vs science

intents.display: to think about whether success is a moving goalpost or a state of mind
